target.statement: AUC-ROC of TabPFN on the Breast Cancer dataset (D1) at 100% minority class (no reduction), averaged over 2x5-fold cross-validation.

compute.basis: Breast Cancer is a tiny UCI dataset (365 samples); TabPFN inference on CPU is fast, and the 2x5 CV protocol is trivial, but the exact preprocessing and TabPFN version are unspecified, so some re-implementation is needed.

blockers: No code or scripts released (available only on request from authors)
Exact preprocessing and TabPFN version not specified
Target is a single point in a figure, not a table cell; exact value must be read off the plot
title: Beyond Rebalancing: Benchmarking Binary Classifiers Under Class Imbalance Without Rebalancing Techniques
